code_improvements_not_yet_identified.details: METHOD_FILES list on line 29-35 only includes 5 of 7 methods. method_openalex.py and method_wikidata.py are excluded. The 20260310 benchmark ran only 5 methods. This means benchmark data is incomplete.

code_improvements_not_yet_identified.title: Cross-reference corroboration in method_hybrid.py has O(n^2) complexity with inflated scoring
code_improvements_not_yet_identified.details: cross_reference_results() compares every entry against every other entry (O(n^2)). With 46+ results this is ~2100 comparisons. The keyword overlap threshold of 3 words is very loose — common terms like 'trading', 'model', 'machine', 'learning' will match most entries in a domain query, inflating corroboration scores artificially. Config 3 research flagged this as INEFF-006.
code_improvements_not_yet_identified.fix: 1) Use inverted keyword index for O(n*k) lookup instead of pairwise. 2) Require higher overlap threshold (5+ keywords) or use TF-IDF weighted overlap instead of raw keyword count. 3) Exclude query terms from corroboration matching.

code_improvements_not_yet_identified.title: method_iterative.py does not use dedup_utils despite it being available
code_improvements_not_yet_identified.details: The iterative method accumulates results across 3 rounds but only deduplicates by URL. Two different URLs can contain the same information. dedup_utils.py with TF-IDF similarity could catch semantic duplicates. This was flagged by Config 2 research (INEFF-009) but never fixed.
code_improvements_not_yet_identified.fix: Import dedup_utils and apply deduplicate_results() to the final result set

code_improvements_not_yet_identified.title: method_openalex.py has bare except clause in search_openalex()
code_improvements_not_yet_identified.details: Line 49 catches all exceptions generically. Should follow the pattern established in method_arxiv.py with specific urllib.error.HTTPError, urllib.error.URLError, and json.JSONDecodeError handling.
code_improvements_not_yet_identified.fix: Replace 'except Exception as e:' with specific exception types

code_improvements_not_yet_identified.title: ddg_utils.py rate limiter uses global mutable state that breaks under ThreadPoolExecutor
code_improvements_not_yet_identified.details: method_hybrid.py runs 5 methods in parallel, each calling ddg_utils.search_duckduckgo(). The rate limiter uses module-level _last_request_time which is shared across threads. Under ThreadPoolExecutor, multiple threads read/write this without synchronization, making the rate limit ineffective and potentially causing race conditions.
code_improvements_not_yet_identified.fix: Use threading.Lock to protect _last_request_time, or use a threading.Semaphore-based rate limiter

code_improvements_not_yet_identified.title: DuckDuckGo fallback search in Wikipedia and arXiv methods makes 3 DDG requests each — adds 6+ seconds when APIs fail
code_improvements_not_yet_identified.details: method_wikipedia.py fallback_wikipedia_search() makes 3 DDG requests. method_arxiv.py fallback_arxiv_search() makes 3 DDG requests. When running in hybrid mode with both APIs down, that's 6 extra DDG requests on top of the main web search, all sequential due to rate limiting at 0.5s each = 3s minimum added latency.
code_improvements_not_yet_identified.fix: Add a timeout or max-fallback-queries parameter. Consider caching DDG results across methods when running in hybrid mode.

code_improvements_not_yet_identified.title: request_cache.py cache key does not account for query parameters embedded in URL differently
code_improvements_not_yet_identified.details: Two URLs like '?a=1&b=2' and '?b=2&a=1' produce different cache keys because the URL string differs. Should normalize URL parameters before hashing.
code_improvements_not_yet_identified.fix: Parse URL, sort query parameters, reconstruct URL before hashing
